summary: The registrant filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to declare regular and special distributions for its Class I, Class S, and Class D common shares, with net distribution amounts ranging from $0.19136 to $0.21000 per share, payable on or about July 31, 2026 to shareholders of record as of June 30, 2026. The filing also discloses the May 31, 2026 NAV per share of $26.32 for each class, aggregate NAV of $549.0 million, portfolio fair value of $954.6 million, and debt outstanding of $430.6 million. Additionally, the fund provides a status update on its continuous registered offering of up to $3.0 billion in shares. This is a routine operational update regarding distributions and offering status; it does not constitute a special situation event.
